ONCO 521.course_name: Molecular and Cell Biology of Cancer
ONCO 521.description: Focuses on molecular and cell biology of cancer through a series of lectures, reviews, student presentations and discussion. Recommended prerequisites: One of BIOL_V 234, BIOL_V 335, BIOC_V 303, MEDG_V 421. [3-0]. Equivalency: PATH_V 531 and MEDG_V 521. Credit will be granted for only one of MEDG_V 521, ONCO_V 521 or PATH_V 531. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.
